category: 2026 DRC-Uganda-France BDBV Outbreak (Active — PHEIC; deadliest and largest ever recorded in DRC)
killed: 2,476 confirmed DRC / 2 confirmed Uganda = 2,478 confirmed total
injured: 2,751 surviving confirmed cases; 730 currently hospitalized in isolation (DRC); Uganda outbreak closed 28 July with 18 recoveries
source: DRC Ministry of Health / ECDC / CIDRAP / NPR / WHO — 19–20 August 2026
note: DRC: 5,208 confirmed cases across 55 of 151 health zones in 6 provinces as of 18 August, published 19 August; 2,476 confirmed deaths; crude national CFR ~47.5%, up from ~20% in early June, reaching approximately 70% in North Kivu province specifically. Uganda: 20 confirmed cases (2 deaths, 18 recoveries), outbreak formally declared over 28 July 2026. France: 1 case, recovered and discharged 4 July, no secondary transmission. WHO estimates true DRC case count could be up to 4x higher than reported. Most deaths continue to occur in communities away from treatment centers. 155 confirmed cases among healthcare workers with 45 deaths (29% CFR). The outbreak formally passed 5,000 cases on 19 August, reaching that scale faster than any prior Ebola outbreak — roughly three times the pace of the 2014-16 West Africa epidemic. On 16 August the death toll surpassed the 2,299 deaths of DRC's 2018-2020 Kivu outbreak, making this the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country's history and the second-largest ever recorded worldwide behind the 2014-16 West Africa epidemic. A second WHO IHR Emergency Committee meeting was held 18 August; Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said 'we must be frank: the epidemic is far from being under control.' In Bunia, Ituri, a mob attacked a health response team and torched an ambulance amid rising community mistrust. On 20 August WHO/Africa CDC announced release of 70,000 Ervebo vaccine doses to DRC (20,000 for a Phase 3 Bundibugyo cross-protection trial, 50,000 for frontline/health workers) — the trial itself had not yet launched as of 20 August. US pledged an additional $242M (5 August), bringing total US assistance above $512M.
